data.body: S1 4f pre-flight caught a REAL defect the implementer missed: it validated with 'pytest tests/unit' only, but CI's make test covers the whole suite. tests/interfaces/store/test_execution_mode_dispatch.py::test_single_turn_runner_builds_agent_with_no_tools failed with AttributeError — module rebar.llm.runner has no attribute '_build_retrying_anthropic_model'. This is a THIRD import/patch site of that symbol; the S1 story scope named only two (test_llm_timeouts.py, test_transport_retry.py), so the story's Scope section was incomplete. That test stubs pydantic_ai as an EMPTY module and patched the builder purely to avoid a real SDK import, so post-S1 both the patch target AND the strategy needed updating (run() now does 'from pydantic_ai.models import infer_model' for a registered provider, which would explode against the empty stub). FIX: replaced the builder patch with a stub of runner_mod.ProviderSession (supports()->False, is_resolvable()->True) which routes run() down its lazy model-STRING path — no infer_model call, no provider build. The test's ASSERTION (single_turn => tools/toolsets empty) was NOT touched; only scaffolding that referenced a symbol which legitimately moved. Verified the assertion still bites by mutating the guarantee (tools=['MUTANT']) => 'AssertionError: assert [MUTANT] == []'. Lesson for remaining stories: dispatch briefs must require the FULL gating suite (make test), not tests/unit.
